verification_notes: All four final native printable parts are valid, closed single solids. The saved STEP contains four matching solids with zero symmetric-difference volume. Saved-document recompute and independent reconstruction of the final parameters reproduce the same geometry.

The four STL files passed single-component closed-manifold topology checks. Normalized supplier meshes retain the corresponding part geometry; each 3MF declares millimetres and contains one mesh/build item. These checks establish file integrity, not process capability.

The final enclosure and fastener envelopes were checked against the corrected 2,949-shape component assembly. No physical component interference was found. Eight raw screw-to-soldermask surface intersections occur only in the presentation mask across the NPTH openings; all lie inside the empty 3.2 mm drill cylinders, and the actual substrate gives the M3 shafts 0.1 mm radial clearance. The raw findings and classification are retained in the audit report.

Model stack: glass top Z19.998719, highest OLED feature Z20.301219 and lid underside Z21. The glass-to-lid-plane gap is 1.001281 mm; the minimum lid-to-OLED clearance is 0.698781 mm. The microphone acoustic face is Z12, leaving 9.0 mm to the lid underside; the hole pattern creates a direct opening, not a tested acoustic duct.

PTT geometric check: after 0.45 mm downward displacement, the flange reaches the cup with zero solid overlap. An additional 0.01 mm produces overlap, confirming the modeled stop. Actual switch operation and permissible travel remain a first-article acceptance item.

Fresh PCB checks report zero ERC violations, zero DRC violations, zero unconnected items and zero schematic-parity issues. The PCB fabrication package contains 98 drill hits and a source-matched four-layer Gerber set. Physical module registration remains unverified against the owned parts.

The four DXF top-reference projections were independently read back through FreeCAD: entity counts matched and maximum XY bound deviation was 0.0242 mm, within the 0.025 mm polyline sampling deflection. STEP controls the exact three-dimensional surfaces. DXFs contain no toolpaths or depths.
